purpose: one fixed same-raw-gene spatial contrast: point Ridge vs fixed output smoothing vs the real-neighbourhood candidate vs whole-section background vs single permuted-graph control; no tuning, no pass threshold
block_scale_nature: all three blocks receive the same 1/sqrt(3) factor so that three copies of one standardised X stay equivalent to the point model under the same alpha; per-channel standardisation still inflates the relative variation of the neighbourhood blocks, so this factor does not equalise capacity
input_rule: each target reads only its frozen full15 visible matrix and QC (infra/field_followup_20261018/genes/{sid}_t{ti}.npy and _qc.npy); no rebuilding from raw counts; the raw HDF5 files are not in the input allowlist at all
column_rule: columns whose standard deviation across the pooled training rows is zero are removed; the rule is determined from training rows only and applied to the corresponding test columns
spatial_features: X = frozen visible genes + QC; E = the existing organ/platform indicator columns reused from the frozen point input. The point design is [X, E]. The neighbourhood design is [X, WX, VX]/sqrt(3) with E appended once, outside the block scaling; background and permuted replace the two neighbourhood blocks correspondingly. WX and VX are base.neighbor_mean(frozen graph, X), so they carry QC as well; E never enters the graph multiplication and is never multiplied by 1/sqrt(3). E keeps exactly the same training-time standardisation and penalty as in the point model. Spatial and background features are built on all tissue spots aligned with the frozen graphs and the frozen training rows are extracted afterwards.
isolated_rule: base.neighbor_mean self fallback for the real graphs and for the permuted graphs (degree multiset is preserved by relabelling)
permutation: one pre-fixed within-section node permutation per section, recorded seed, applied to both the near and the outer graph (P W P^T, P V P^T); barcodes, coordinates, rows of X and targets keep their original order; exactly one permutation, never selected on any score
smoothing: 0.5 * (point_ridge + neighbor_mean(near, point_ridge)) using the frozen near graph and its self fallback

tolerances.block_equivalence_rule: EQUIVALENCE IS CHECKED ON THE FORMAL DESIGN: the two neighbourhood blocks are replaced by copies of the gene/QC block X, so the check compares [X,X,X]/sqrt(3) with E once and unscaled against the formal point [X,E]; the wrong-scale negative control (block scale 1.0) is kept. The bound is the fixed 1e-5 and is never expanded from new observations; the measured solver floor and the conditioning are recorded as indicators only. HISTORY, recorded as a change and not as a non-change: the earlier bound was 1e-6, the measured residual was 6.18e-6 and the check therefore failed; the bound was then set to 1e-5 on the numerical basis (same design, cholesky vs lsqr 3.40e-6; regularised Gram conditioning about 5.2e5; wrong-scale control 2.11e-4, about 34x the residual). Round-1 review accepted the numerical reasoning but rejected the wording that this was not a relaxation; this clause now states it plainly. If the residual exceeds 1e-5, stop and investigate the cause; do not widen the bound and do not select alpha or the scale on any internal or source score.
tolerances.reason: the frozen source-holdout recompute showed about 4.6e-05 point differences and 4.12e-06 per-section RMSE differences; these tolerances are fixed before the run and are numerical, not biological; exceeding them stops the run and requires a cause, never a wider tolerance and never a different baseline

metric_binding: reuses the reviewed definitions of Git 5fee80f: local detail Pearson is the correlation of the two detail components (v - neighbourhood mean), Jaccard uses the strict-above-quantile rule with q75 as the primary description, radius absolute deviation takes abs() per section before complete-unit aggregation, 0 is a valid value and never a missing value
claim_rule: a readout is only described as beyond the ordinary explanations when the candidate is favourable against point, fixed smoothing, background and permutation at the same time; that is a descriptive conjunction, not a pass threshold and not a p-value

evidence_roles.measurement_reference: frozen measured readout y and its descriptors
evidence_roles.spatial_contrast: exploratory mechanistic contrast on developed material; predictions share visible genes with their inputs, so input echo is present
evidence_roles.permutation_control: single mechanism-destruction control, not a null model and not a p-value

not_run: human TLS labels or structural validation
input-size search (the 5-module question was answered earlier)
tuning of alpha, block scale, neighbourhood radius, input or target
